name: io.github.gege-mn/ray-mcp
title: Ray notifications
description: Send email, push, Slack, Discord, Telegram and webhook notifications and manage templates with Ray.

environmentVariables.name: RAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ray API key (ck_live_...). Create one at https://ray.gege.mn under API keys; use the write scope to send and edit.

environmentVariables.name: RAY_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hosted Ray MCP endpoint to bridge to. Only change this for self-hosted or staging deployments.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your Ray API key, created at https://ray.gege.mn under API keys.
